import numpy as np
idx=np.argsort(P)
print(np.c_[t,P,dP_dt][:15])
# fit logistic-ish: dP/dt vs P
A=np.c_[np.ones_like(P),P,P**2]
c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
print("quad fit in P",c, 1-np.sum((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2))
A=np.c_[np.ones_like(P),P,P**2,t,t*P,t**2]
c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
print(c, 1-np.sum((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2))

A=np.c_[np.ones_like(P),P,P**2]
c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
r=dP_dt-A@c
for name,x in [('t',t),('P',P)]:
    o=np.argsort(x)
    print(name, [round(np.mean(r[o][i:i+30]),3) for i in range(0,300,30)])
print(np.corrcoef(np.c_[t,P,r].T))

for deg in [3,4,5,6]:
    A=np.c_[[P**k for k in range(deg+1)]].T
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    print(deg, 1-np.sum((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2))
A=np.c_[[P**k for k in range(4)]].T
c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]

# with t-dependent coefficients

c2=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
print(np.round(c2,4), 1-np.sum((B@c2-dP_dt)**2)/np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2))

A=np.c_[[P**k for k in range(4)]].T

def R(B):
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.round(c,4), round(1-np.sum((B@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2),6)
